label: restore-wayne-fcm5-compiled-reference
command: import pathlib,hashlib,json,xml.etree.ElementTree as E; p=pathlib.Path("research/base-miku-a15/system/system/etc/vintf/compatibility_matrix.5.xml");out=pathlib.Path("config/compatibility_matrix.5.xml");out.write_bytes(p.read_bytes());d={"source":str(p),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"kernel_requirements":[x.attrib for x in E.parse(p).getroot().findall("kernel")]};pathlib.Path("config/fcm5-source.json").write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2));print(json.dumps(d))
